content: color-mix() shipped in Safari 15 (Sept 2021, WebKit) with full spec support by Safari 18; Chromium/Edge (WebView2 inherits Chromium) supported it earlier and fully from Chromium 125. Risk for StorCat is specifically the Linux AppImage build, which depends on the system-installed webkit2gtk rather than a bundled runtime -- older LTS distro webkit2gtk builds may predate color-mix() support.
